text.7:77: So they hamstrung the she-camel, and they flouted the commandment of their Lord, and they said: O Salih! Bring upon us that thou threatenest if thou art indeed of those sent (from Allah).
text.11:65: But they hamstrung her, and then he said: Enjoy life in your dwelling-place three days! This is a threat that will not be belied.
text.26:157: But they hamstrung her, and then were penitent.
text.54:29: But they call their comrade and he took and hamstrung (her).
text.91:14: But they denied him, and they hamstrung her, so Allah doomed them for their sin and rased (their dwellings).
